title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Network & Connectivity

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.
  • Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).
  • Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.

Wireless, Load Balancing & Security

  • Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.
  • Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.
  • Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design.

Automation, IaC & Observability

  • Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible.
  • Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.
  • Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.
  • Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.
  • Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations).
  • Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.
  • Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.
  • Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.
  • Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).
  • Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture.
  • Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams.
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking.
  • Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.
  • Prior experience in distributed or global organizations.

Location

This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.

Our Benefits – Brazil

For Employees Based In Brazil, We Offer

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale-Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for This Role

This role follows our hybrid work model . Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model.

Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato; Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra‑estrutura do Contrato; Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA Tensão no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato; Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas; Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra‑estrutura do Contrato; Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato; Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças; Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos; Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia; Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção; description:
Descrição da vaga

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

  • People with disabilities (PcD - pessoa com deficiencia)
  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior (Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e desejável conhecimento em NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades

  • Proteção Catódica: gerenciar e acompanhar sistemas de proteção catódica de dutos, incluindo monitoramento de potenciais, desempenho de retificadores, interferências eletromagnéticas e condições de corrosão externa. Analisar resultados de levantamentos de campo (CIPS, DCVG, PCM/A-Frame, entre outros) e propor ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Inspeção e Integridade: Planejar, acompanhar e aprovar atividades de inspeção e integridade de dutos e equipamentos, com foco em mecanismos de corrosão interna e externa. Avaliar ameaças à integridade (corrosão, interferências, SCC, danos mecânicos, defeitos de fabricação e soldagem).
  • Avaliação de Defeitos: Realizar análises de defeitos com base em normas técnicas (API 579, ASME B31.G, B31.8, entre outras).
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Atualizar e acompanhar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de suporte ao gestor.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Orientar técnicos, promover boas práticas de inspeção e fortalecer a cultura de integridade.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Selecionar, contratar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção e integridade em campo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em proteção catódica, integridade de dutos e desejável NR‑13.
  • Domínio: Proteção Catódica, Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento: NR‑13, SPIE, Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.

Diferencial

  • Atuação ou disponibilidade para atuar como PLH.
  • Certificações em inspeção/END/soldagem.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Participação em eventos e fóruns técnicos.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.

Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

  • Estruturar e fortalecer controles operacionais e financeiros relacionados ao fluxo de recebimentos e liquidação.

  • Organização e forte atenção a detalhes

  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade financeira

description:
Descrição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Auxiliar Administrativo de Call Center / Atendimento para integrar nossa equipe e oferecer suporte nas rotinas de atendimento ao cliente/associado.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Excel intermediário
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas
  • Facilidade com tecnologia e sistemas de atendimento
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas administrativas ou atendimento será considerada um diferencial

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Identificar rapidamente a natureza da ocorrência (pane mecânica, colisão, furto, chaveiro, encanador, etc.).
  • Localizar e enviar o recurso necessário (guincho, socorro mecânico, táxi ou técnico) via sistema, utilizando geolocalização.
  • Acompanhar o deslocamento do prestador e manter o associado informado sobre a previsão de chegada.
  • Manter a calma e passar segurança para o associado, que pode estar em uma situação de risco ou estresse na via pública.
  • Validar se o plano do associado cobre o serviço solicitado e se ainda possui "limite de acionamentos" ou quilometragem disponível para o guincho.
  • Informar custos extras caso o serviço ultrapasse o limite contratado (ex: quilometragem excedente de guincho).
  • Documentar com precisão o local exato da ocorrência, pontos de referência e o estado do bem (veículo ou imóvel) para fins de perícia posterior.
  • Orientar o associado sobre procedimentos imediatos (ex: sinalizar a pista, aguardar em local seguro) enquanto o auxílio não chega.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Comunicação Assertiva: Saber transmitir informações de forma clara, pausada e objetiva.
  • Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de ouvir o cliente com atenção para entender a dor real antes de propor uma solução.
  • Resiliência e Controle Emocional: Saber lidar com clientes insatisfeitos ou situações de conflito mantendo o profissionalismo.
  • Empatia: Colocar-se no lugar do cliente para gerar uma conexão e humanizar o atendimento.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha crescer com a Cardway

Na Cardway, acreditamos que conexões bem construídas movem negócios e transformam trajetórias.

Somos uma empresa de meios de pagamento movida por pessoas, tecnologia e relacionamento, em um ambiente onde você pode aprender, se desenvolver e ver o impacto do seu trabalho no crescimento da companhia e dos nossos parceiros.

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento, e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói resultados juntos, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

Sobre a Cardway

A Cardway é uma empresa brasileira de meios de pagamento e soluções digitais, formada a partir da união entre o Grupocard e a Movilway, duas referências no mercado que somam décadas de expertise e inovação no setor.

Atuamos com um portfólio completo e integrado de soluções que reúne meios de pagamento, telecom, serviços digitais, mobilidade urbana, serviços bancários e a plataforma CardHub, conectando tudo em um único ecossistema para nossos parceiros.

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

  • Compromisso com Parceiros e Clientes
  • Transparência
  • Excelência na Prática
  • Colaboração
  • Responsabilidade

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem quando as pessoas se sentem parte e trabalham juntas em um ambiente ético, colaborativo e bem estruturado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Consultor de Vendas , você terá um papel fundamental na construção de relacionamento com nossos clientes e parceiros, ajudando a levar nossas soluções a cada ponto de venda.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atrair, conquistar e encantar clientes, criando conexões que gerem valor e relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Apresentar produtos com precisão, destacando diferenciais, preços e condições, além de orientar sobre o pós-venda.
  • Realizar comparativos de preços e benefícios, facilitando a decisão de compra com clareza e confiança.
  • Negociar com clientes externos, elaborar propostas comerciais, fechar vendas e ampliar a carteira de parceiros.
  • Garantir o abastecimento dos pontos de venda, oferecendo suporte contínuo e acompanhando a performance dos produtos.
  • Manter o padrão visual da marca com instalação e manutenção de materiais de merchandising.
  • Atualizar cadastros e controlar o estoque com atenção e responsabilidade.

Local de atuação: São Gonçalo/RJ

Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e construir relacionamentos de confiança com nossos parceiros.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • CNH válida (categoria B)
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para atuação em campo
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos na região de atuação

Competência e habilidades:

  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas
  • Organização e autonomia para planejar sua rotina e visitas
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver na área Comercial

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Parceria com TotalPass
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Vale Natal
  • Convênio com SESC
  • Atendimento médico gratuito viaConexa Saúde
  • Convênio PET com a Guapeco (descontos e benefícios para cuidados com seu pet)
  • Ressarcimento de Despesas de Uso de Veículo

Além de um pacote de benefícios completo, você também terá acesso à Uniway, nossa plataforma de educação corporativa, com cursos e treinamentos para apoiar seu crescimento.

Diversidade importa (e muito!)

Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

Processo seletivo seguro e transparente

A Cardway não realiza qualquer tipo de cobrança, solicitação de curso pago ou taxa em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo. Todas as comunicações oficiais são feitas exclusivamente por canais da empresa.

Em caso de dúvida, entre em contato com o nosso time de Recrutamento e Seleção pelo e-mail:

Nosso compromisso é garantir um processo ético, seguro e transparente para todos!

Se conectou com essa oportunidade? Então se inscreva e venha crescer com a gente!

title: Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager
description:
Department

Broadcast & Media Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY : We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP : We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE : We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING : We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION : We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION : We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY : We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portugues. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: ANALISTA DE PROCESSOS E PROJETOS PLENO - CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (INCLUSIVA PARA PCD).
description:
A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

A área de Customer Experience da Leve Saúde atua de forma estratégica na melhoria contínua da jornada do beneficiário, conectando dados, operação e transformação.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos e Projetos Pleno para atuar no time de Customer Experience (CX), sendo responsável por conduzir iniciativas de melhoria da jornada do cliente, com foco em gerar impacto real para o cliente e para o negócio.

Procuramos uma pessoa com perfil mão na massa, organizado e protagonista , que tenha autonomia para conduzir projetos, navegar entre áreas e transformar problemas em soluções práticas.

A Leve é uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, por isso, mais do que seguir um escopo rígido, esperamos alguém disposto a construir, adaptar e evoluir junto com a área , com potencial para assumir desafios cada vez mais complexos ao longo do tempo.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos estruturantes de melhoria da jornada do cliente, do diagnóstico à implementação;
  • Gerenciar iniciativas utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e etc),incluindo gestão de backlog e priorização a partir de metodologia;
  • Traduzir dados e insights da Voz do Cliente em planos de ação estruturados;
  • Apoiar na gestão de mudanças, reduzindo o impacto no cliente e garantindo a adoção das melhorias pelas áreas envolvidas;
  • Mapear e redesenhar processos e jornadas do cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir workshops e rituais de projetos (brainstorming, planning, sprint e reviews);
  • Articular com diferentes áreas (operação, rede, relacionamento, tecnologia, etc.) para garantir a execução e sucesso das entregas;
  • Elaborar materiais com storytelling claro e objetivo, evidenciando resultados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores e garantir a mensuração dos resultados das iniciativas implementadas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas, incluindo inteligência artificial, para otimizar análises, organização e execução das atividades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Processos, Tecnologia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e melhoria de processos;
  • Vivência na gestão de squads, aplicação de metodologias ágeis e condução de projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento, organização, gestão de riscos, acompanhamento de cronogramas e comunicação com stakeholders diversos;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e apoiar na geração de insights;
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento e redesenho de processos/jornadas;
  • Habilidade de construção de materiais executivos com storytelling;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Pacote Google, Office, Jira, Bizagi e Miro.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Customer Experience ou Jornada do cliente;
  • Vivência em empresas de saúde ou operações complexas;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn);
  • Experiência com gestão de mudanças estruturadas;
  • Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho;
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, automação dE processos ou implantação de tecnologias.

title: Referee Operations Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas. The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.
  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.
  • Be very dynamic, stress‑resistant, motivated, excellent interpersonal and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people of other cultures and backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • High energy levels, exceptional planning and organizational skills, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Portuguese and English are mandatory, and Spanish is a great plus.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Partner Rights Delivery Manager
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Partnerships & Media

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition‑related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Assist in coordinating and delivering stadium inspections, open days, and Commercial Partner operational visits, ensuring alignment with commercial and F&B concessions requirements.
  • Manage and monitor the implementation of FIFA’s clean site obligation and Commercial Partners’ exclusivity in the official sites.
  • Ensure the Commercial Partners’ recognition programme is correctly implemented in designated stadium areas in accordance with established guidelines, including within the F&B concessions programme.
  • Assist in the implementation of specific commercial/marketing projects at the stadiums, such as Stadium Fan Experience areas, Special Marketing Programmes, Youth Programme, Value‑in‑Kind (VIK) operations, LED pitch side board operations, and other Commercial Partner activities, in coordination with the FIFA/FIFA27 project leads and the entire Partnership Rights Delivery team.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.
  • Provide operational support to the Partnership Rights Delivery Venue Team (Marketing Venue Managers) during the tournament period.
  • Take primary responsibility for the administrative preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive documentation, operational guidelines, briefing materials, tracking tools, and structured reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency across all Partnership Rights Delivery activities.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, guidelines, and presentations on rights delivery progress, highlighting key achievements, risks, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the preparation of tournament debrief documentation.
  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree, ideally in Sports Management, Sports Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, with exposure to commercial/marketing operations or sponsorship activations.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced, and project‑driven environment, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial operations and/or sponsorship activations in major event settings and/or the sports industry.
  • Experience working in international sports events or large‑scale event environments is considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.Experience in the planning and delivery of fan experience areas and activations is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Very strong administrative skills, with proven ability to produce high‑quality documentation, guidelines, reports, and structured tracking tools.
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and a structured working approach.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and deliver projects within an event environment, manage priorities effectively, and work independently within defined responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Service‑oriented mindset with a proactive and solution‑driven approach to commercial rights delivery.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and perform effectively under tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistence, and resilience in dynamic environments.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

title: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
description:
Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description:
Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil.

De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100).

Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova.

Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador

Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço.

É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão.

Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos:

O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar.

2-Técnico de Necropsia

O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil.

As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais.

As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias.

Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos.

O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso.

Atribuições

Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso.

5-Delegado de Polícia

O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres:

  • Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública;
  • Assegurar a observância da lei;
  • Defender as instituições públicas;
  • Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais;
  • Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais;
  • Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital.

Etapas do concurso

A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital.

O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social.

Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio

O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo deAuxiliar de Necropsia daPolícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já paraTécnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59.

OInspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38.

A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95.

Detalhes do concurso

  • Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ)
  • Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior

Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • To prepare a variety of designs from Agri bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • To prepare a variety of designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • To perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Preparing design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • To design other projects such as piping to support in other projects such as liquid bulk terminal and utilities which will include piping design using either Plant 3D or similar software
  • To generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • To assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other Duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions® serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.

  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.

  • Risk management mindset
Certifications & Requirements

  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will lead the creative development and localisation of Brand Graphic assets ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football. Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Solid experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Own, drive and oversee creative process and localisation across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Inline with Brand Guidelines and central Brand direction, direct and produce creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.

Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead junior designer and external creative partners to deliver cohesive, high-impact work across formats and platforms.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative outputs with business and brand objectives.
  • Brief, manage, and evaluate external agencies, production partners, ensuring creative alignment and production quality.

Brand Guardianship & Design Systems

  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS -ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Important : Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in senior graphic or art direction roles within agency, sports events or Entertainment.

Competencies and Personality

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design solid experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collateral
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands-on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Rigor

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Organizar o trabalho do projeto Apoio a Distância (SAD) que irá começar no Morro dos Cabritos em Copacabana.

Elaborar diagnóstico social de famílias e comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade ade e promover a elaboração, implementação e monitoramento de planos de acompanhamento familiar.

Promover o acesso a direitos sociais e políticas públicas (assistência, saúde, educação, habitação);

Articular as famílias com a rede socioassistencial e intersetorial (CRAS, CREAS, escolas, unidades de saúde, Judiciário);

Elaborar relatórios sociais, pareceres técnicos e estudos de caso;

Job Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Communications

Location

Brazil

The Position

The Senior Graphic Designer at FWWC27 LTDA, FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will lead the creative development and localisation of Brand Graphic assets ensuring consistent, world‑class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women's World Cup to be held in South America, with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. The role reports to the Global head of Brand, Marketing & Promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Solid experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Own, drive and oversee creative process and localisation across channels ensuring high‑quality outcomes aligned with FIFA's brand vision.
  • Inline with Brand Guidelines and central Brand direction, direct and produce creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital‑first creative assets.

Project Leadership & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Lead junior designer and external creative partners to deliver cohesive, high‑impact work across formats and platforms.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative outputs with business and brand objectives.
  • Brief, manage, and evaluate external agencies, production partners, ensuring creative alignment and production quality.

Brand Guardianship & Design Systems

  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA's visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven hands‑on expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large‑scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Minimum 8‑10 years of experience in senior graphic or art‑direction roles within agency, sports events or entertainment.

Competencies and Personality

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design solid experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collateral.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High‑level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Rigor

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines, with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

Leadership & Management

  • Experience managing in‑house teams and/or agency relationships, including budget oversight.
  • Strong understanding of FIFA's global image and strategic objectives, with a deep respect for the role of women's football and culture.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a service‑oriented, can‑do attitude and appetite for innovation.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.
