This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru.

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self‑motivated, creative team member integral to the long‑term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

Responsibilities

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy & Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy & Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Working Conditions

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

title: Asbestos Surveyor
description:
Shape Safer Environments Through Technical Excellence

Every building has a story hidden within its structure. As an Asbestos Surveyor, you’ll be the person who uncovers the detail, applies technical expertise and ensures that clients across the UK can make informed, safe and confident decisions. If you enjoy autonomy, thrive in varied environments and take pride in accuracy and clarity, this role offers genuine scope to grow, influence and create meaningful impact.

We have multiple roles available that will either cover locations across the Southeast and London or solely cover the Darlington area in the Northeast. In addition to the very competitive salary and overtime rates, we also offer a company car or a car allowance, giving you the flexibility and support you need for your role.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

This role exists to deliver high quality, UKAS compliant asbestos surveying services across a wide-ranging portfolio of commercial and industrial properties. You will carry out management, refurbishment and demolition surveys, collecting precise inspection data and producing clear, robust reports aligned with UKAS accreditation and HSE guidance. Working largely independently on client sites, you will conduct detailed inspections, bulk sampling and risk assessments, offering technically sound insights that support compliance, risk control and asset management. You will work closely with internal quality and project teams while interacting directly with clients, facilities personnel and other stakeholders.

Reporting to the Regional Operations Manager, you will operate across offices, public buildings, retail, healthcare, education, manufacturing and infrastructure environments. The role involves travelling to multiple sites, managing personal workloads and deadlines, and ensuring exceptional data integrity. All work is supported by digital surveying tools, structured reporting systems and a mature quality assurance framework.

Your Impact in This Position

In the early stages, you will establish yourself as a dependable technical specialist, delivering consistently high quality surveys and building trusted relationships with both clients and colleagues. As your experience deepens, you will gain exposure to larger, more complex survey projects and play a part in service improvements and broader consultancy activities. This includes involvement in major commercial and industrial projects, reinspection projects and asbestos management reviews.

Longer‑term, this position offers multiple progression pathways, including senior surveying responsibilities, technical auditing, project management or leadership roles within the consultancy. Ongoing professional development and access to diverse sites and contracts provide a strong foundation for sustained career growth.

Core Capabilities

  • Asbestos Surveying – Plan and deliver comprehensive management, refurbishment and demolition surveys across commercial and industrial environments, identifying and sampling asbestos‑containing materials with precision.
  • Asbestos Expertise – Serve as the trusted technical authority, understanding asbestos materials, behaviours and associated risks across demanding sectors such as aviation, pharmaceuticals and utilities.
  • Regulatory Compliance and Technical Knowledge – Apply asbestos legislation and industry standards with confidence, ensuring every survey is compliant, proportionate and grounded in evidence.
  • Data Capturing, Reporting & Quality Assurance – Record detailed observations, assessments and sample information using digital platforms, and produce well‑structured technical reports that reflect attention to detail and clarity.
  • Client Communication & Consultancy Skills – Communicate technical findings clearly and professionally, fostering trust and providing proportionate, actionable advice to clients, facilities teams and project managers.

Qualifications & Experience

You will hold BOHS P402 or an equivalent RSPH qualification, along with demonstrable experience of undertaking asbestos surveys within a UKAS accredited setting. You will already be authorised for management, refurbishment and demolition surveys and bring strong IT, literacy and numeracy skills. A full UK driving licence is essential.

Working Environment

We support flexible arrangements, including three or four day working weeks. Overtime opportunities may be available and are remunerated at enhanced rates. You will plan site visits in advance to support effective scheduling and maintain a healthy work‑life balance. Periodic office attendance is expected for collaboration, training, quality reviews and wider team engagement. The role involves regular travel to client sites and occasional support for out‑of‑hours projects.

Why join Tetra Tech?

Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity.

We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems.

In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day‑to‑day role.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on this list and any submitted will be taken as a gift. Please refer to the careers page on our website if you require any further information.

description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

We are hiring for a Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA) at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full-time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands-on environment and grow into long-term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.

title: Business Intelligence
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, Business Intelligence is more than dashboards and reports—it is about turning data into insight that supports better decisions across the business. We are looking for a Business Intelligence professional who can translate complex data into clear, actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, performance management, and operational excellence in a dynamic offshore environment.

If you are motivated by data‑driven decision making and value openness, collaboration, and transparent communication, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are

We are more than a supply service company—we are a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you will join a close‑knit and collaborative team, working closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Operations.

You will collaborate with colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their expertise to help navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do. Our work environment is flexible, energized, and inclusive. Ideas are not only heard—they are valued. We celebrate diversity and believe that \"we\" comes before \"I\". Through close collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual respect, we create a space where your voice matters and your contributions drive real impact.

What You Will Be Doing

The Business Intelligence role sits at the core of our Finance organisation and plays a key role in enabling informed decision making across the business.

In this role, you will support strategic and operational decisions by ensuring leadership and key stakeholders have access to reliable, structured, and meaningful insights. Your work will support performance tracking, forecasting, planning, and ad‑hoc analysis—helping the organisation understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what actions to take.

You will be responsible for collecting, structuring, and analysing data from multiple internal and external sources, transforming raw data into intuitive dashboards, visualisations, and reports that support leadership discussions and business execution.

A key focus in your first months will be strengthening data structures, improving data quality, and contributing to the development of business intelligence tools that support management reporting, planning cycles, and strategic initiatives. You will also play an important role in ensuring that data assumptions are challenged, insights are clearly communicated, and decision‑making is based on a solid analytical foundation.

Who You Are

You are driven by curiosity and motivated by understanding how data and insights influence business decisions. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, taking ownership of your analyses, and translating complexity into clarity:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
  • MBA or CFA will be considered a plus.
  • You have 2–5 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Financial Analysis, FP&A, or a similar analytical role, preferably within a large international organisation or a complex business environment.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex datasets, integrating multiple data sources, and using tools such as Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • A solid ability to analyse performance, trends, and drivers, and translate findings into clear recommendations for management.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills, enabling you to present insights in a structured, concise, and impactful way.
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced environment, taking ownership of your work while collaborating closely with others to achieve shared goals.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 17 April 2026. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Workforce, People & Culture

Location

Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager, the Volunteer Communications and Engagement Coordinator will play a key role in shaping the volunteer experience for thousands of volunteers across the eight host cities. You will help integrate, craft, and deliver inspiring, informative, and consistent messaging that keeps our volunteers engaged and connected throughout their journey — before, during, and after the tournament.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the daily operations of the Volunteer Communications and Engagement team by assisting the Communications & Engagement Manager with internal and external deliverables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, copywriting emails, dashboards, articles, and newsletters in both English and Portuguese; updating communications on the volunteer platform; coordinating content for social media and internal channels; and providing additional support as needed.
  • Update and maintain the Volunteer Platform (Volunteer Management System) according to the communication needs of each Volunteer journey milestone, ensuring all content and templates are accurate and ready for use.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of communication strategies that foster volunteer engagement across all phases of the programme. From application, recruitment, role offer, training until the end of the tournament and their participation.
  • Support the design and delivery of a comprehensive volunteer engagement strategy, including key messaging and content pillars aligned with the tournament’s values.
  • Support the development and delivery of the Recognition Programme, including overseeing orders and brand approvals for volunteer gifts.
  • Draft and edit compelling content, including volunteer guides, FAQs, and platform updates, tailored for internal platforms, social media, and volunteer contact centres.
  • Coordinate content production, including graphic design requests and translation workflows (English, Portuguese).
  • Create editorial content for key channels such as the FIFA Volunteer Instagram, FIFA Home, and the FWWC2027 Volunteer Newsletter.
  • Assist in planning and executing volunteer events and promotional activities that build community and enhance the volunteer experience.
  • Provide administrative and project support across the Volunteer Communications team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders as needed.
  • Support planning and development of a content plan for the different milestones.
  • Coordinate and support the collection, curation, and writing of volunteer profiles, stories, captions, and visual narratives for the “Volunteer Profile Bank”, capturing content from volunteers in all eight host cities.
  • Help organize and coordinate volunteer participation in media activities, interviews, and events.
  • Organize, curate, and maintain an updated library of volunteer-related assets (brand identity files, photos, videos, templates, guidelines, etc.).
  • Ensure all assets are easy to locate, properly labelled, and accessible to the team.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Project Management, or related field, or similar level of higher education
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a communications function
  • Experience in operating a Volunteer Management Platform or CRM
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to see the big picture and adapt accordingly
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables
  • Previous professional or volunteer experience in major sports events is highly desirable
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project), planning software, and online collaboration tools
  • Knowledge of HTML coding is a plus
  • Design skills and proficiency with design suites (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Figma), as well as content creation apps such as CapCut and SCRL, are considered an asset
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 05 May (tentative or to be agreed)

description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for aSenior Data Engineer (SQL DBA) at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

Competencies:

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full-time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands-on environment and grow into long-term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

title: Content Services Liaison Manager
description:
Content Services Liaison Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Content Services Liaison Manager will report jointly to the Zurich-based FWWC Content Services Project Lead. The successful candidate will be responsible for the planning and coordination of all event-related video content production, as well as ensuring the successful delivery of pre-event and in-tournament video content to FIFA stakeholders.

The Content Services Liaison Manager will be the in-country point of contact for all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives or stadium authorities and FIFA’s Media Partners in relation to non-live content services.

The successful individual will work closely with the FIFA Content Services team at FIFA HQ, Zurich to develop content strategies for the event, as well as communicating the confirmed content plans (long-form, short-form, social, audio) to all relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include 1 year to go, the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, 100 days to go and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and long operational hours. The selected candidate will also be expected to elevate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee all pre-event content production based on the overall tournament content-plan developed in close collaboration with the FIFA Content Services Team in Zurich.
  • Ensure all content creation and delivery for the tournament is communicated clearly and promoted to all stakeholders.
  • Liaise with the FIFA team in Zurich around the creation and distribution of all future content. Report all developments to the Head of Production and work closely with all areas of the FIFA content team.
  • Liaise closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts to ensure they are informed about and engaged with all filming projects and that their individual content requirements are taken care of.
  • Potentially liaise with the North- and South American Media Partners (MP) to coordinate the delivery of produced content, discuss long and short-form programming opportunities and social media packages and assets – to be done in conjunction with FIFA Zurich.
  • Investigate new North and South American based opportunities around potential long and short-form programming, branded content, social media and audio projects, including podcasts.
  • Lead weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, manage and resolve risks and issues for FWWC content services related topics within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Content Services Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Work across multiple time zones, to support the FIFA Content Services Project Lead based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office.
  • Work closely with the local Host Broadcast and Media Partnerships department as their main point of contact for any FIFA Content Services related topics.
  • Pre-plan, onsite support and supervision of the content production for the Play off Final tournaments, the Final Draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A strong background in editorial sports television production or sports television production management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a producer or production manager in a comparable content production related role within a fast-paced environment involving complex projects – ideally at a similar international sports event.
  • A knowledge of and participation in the South American Sports TV industry.
  • Contacts within the national football associations in South America.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized and proven to be cool‑headed under pressure.
  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Esta é uma vaga PcD, nesse papel você irá cuidar das crianças, dos espaços e materiais, e também auxiliar o(a) professor(a) em suas atribuições e rotina.

O que você fará:

  • Acolher e acompanhar a rotina das crianças;
  • Observar crianças e interagir em atividades do dia a dia;
  • Zelar pela boa organização do espaço;
  • Orientar as crianças a manterem uma relação respeitosa e colaborativa entre elas;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Salvaguardar nossas crianças e jovens.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em andamento ou completa de Pedagogia ou Psicologia;
  • Boa compreensão do ambiente escolar;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Nossos auxiliares de professor devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Experiência no segmento da vaga.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Consultor de Vendas – Nova Iguaçu e Duque de Caxias/RJ
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha crescer com a Cardway

Na Cardway, acreditamos que conexões bem construídas movem negócios e transformam trajetórias.

Somos uma empresa de meios de pagamento movida por pessoas, tecnologia e relacionamento, em um ambiente onde você pode aprender, se desenvolver e ver o impacto do seu trabalho no crescimento da companhia e dos nossos parceiros.

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento, e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói resultados juntos, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

Sobre a Cardway

A Cardway é uma empresa brasileira de meios de pagamento e soluções digitais, formada a partir da união entre o Grupocard e a Movilway, duas referências no mercado que somam décadas de expertise e inovação no setor.

Atuamos com um portfólio completo e integrado de soluções que reúne meios de pagamento, telecom, serviços digitais, mobilidade urbana, serviços bancários e a plataforma CardHub, conectando tudo em um único ecossistema para nossos parceiros.

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

  • Compromisso com Parceiros e Clientes
  • Transparência
  • Excelência na Prática
  • Colaboração
  • Responsabilidade

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem quando as pessoas se sentem parte e trabalham juntas em um ambiente ético, colaborativo e bem estruturado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Consultor de Vendas, você terá um papel fundamental na construção de relacionamento com nossos clientes e parceiros, ajudando a levar nossas soluções a cada ponto de venda.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atrair, conquistar e encantar clientes, criando conexões que gerem valor e relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Apresentar produtos com precisão, destacando diferenciais, preços e condições, além de orientar sobre o pós-venda.
  • Realizar comparativos de preços e benefícios, facilitando a decisão de compra com clareza e confiança.
  • Negociar com clientes externos, elaborar propostas comerciais, fechar vendas e ampliar a carteira de parceiros.
  • Garantir o abastecimento dos pontos de venda, oferecendo suporte contínuo e acompanhando a performance dos produtos.
  • Manter o padrão visual da marca com instalação e manutenção de materiais de merchandising.
  • Atualizar cadastros e controlar o estoque com atenção e responsabilidade.

Local de Atuação: Nova Iguaçu e Duque de Caxias/RJ

Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e construir relacionamentos de confiança com nossos parceiros.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • CNH válida (categoria B)
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para atuação em campo
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos na região de atuação

Competência e habilidades:

  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas
  • Organização e autonomia para planejar sua rotina e visitas
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver na área Comercial

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Parceria com TotalPass
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Vale Natal
  • Convênio com SESC
  • Atendimento médico gratuito viaConexa Saúde
  • Convênio PET com a Guapeco (descontos e benefícios para cuidados com seu pet)
  • Ressarcimento de Despesas de Uso de Veículo

Além de um pacote de benefícios completo, você também terá acesso à Uniway, nossa plataforma de educação corporativa, com cursos e treinamentos para apoiar seu crescimento.

Diversidade importa (e muito!)

Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

Processo seletivo seguro e transparente

A Cardway não realiza qualquer tipo de cobrança, solicitação de curso pago ou taxa em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo. Todas as comunicações oficiais são feitas exclusivamente por canais da empresa.

Em caso de dúvida, entre em contato com o nosso time de Recrutamento e Seleção pelo e-mail:

Nosso compromisso é garantir um processo ético, seguro e transparente para todos!

  1. Prospectar clientes corporativos de diferentes perfis (grandes empresas, pequenas empresas, cooperativas, PJs e MEIs), estabelecendo relacionamentos de longo prazo.

  10. Monitorar o mercado e concorrência, fornecendo informações estratégicas para a gerência comercial.
  11. Cumprir normas, políticas internas e padrões da marca, assegurando compliance e qualidade no atendimento.

  4. Noções de gestão de frota, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) e financiamento corporativo, inclusive para pequenas empresas e MEIs.
  5. Capacidade de análise de mercado, concorrência e elaboração de propostas comerciais adaptadas ao porte e perfil do cliente.

Soft Skills (Competências Comportamentais)

  1. Orientação para resultados e resiliência frente a negociações complexas, tanto com grandes grupos quanto pequenos empreendedores.
  2. Comunicação clara, persuasiva e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal com públicos diversos (empresas, cooperativas e profissionais autônomos).
  3. Proatividade e visão estratégica no desenvolvimento de negócios em diferentes perfis de clientes.

  5. Ética profissional e comprometimento com os valores da empresa e da marca.

Nossa cultura respeita as individualidades e potencializa as pessoas com inovação, colaboração e autonomia. title: Partner Rights Delivery Manager
description:
Partner Rights Delivery Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Assist in coordinating and delivering stadium inspections, open days, and Commercial Partner operational visits, ensuring alignment with commercial and F&B concessions requirements.
  • Manage and monitor the implementation of FIFA’s clean site obligation and Commercial Partners’ exclusivity in the official sites.
  • Ensure the Commercial Partners’ recognition programme is correctly implemented in designated stadium areas in accordance with established guidelines, including within the F&B concessions programme.
  • Assist in the implementation of specific commercial/marketing projects at the stadiums, such as Stadium Fan Experience areas, Special Marketing Programmes, Youth Programme, Value-in-Kind (VIK) operations, LED pitch side board operations, and other Commercial Partner activities, in coordination with the FIFA/FIFA27 project leads and the entire Partnership Rights Delivery team.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.
  • Provide operational support to the Partnership Rights Delivery Venue Team (Marketing Venue Managers) during the tournament period.
  • Take primary responsibility for the administrative preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive documentation, operational guidelines, briefing materials, tracking tools, and structured reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency across all Partnership Rights Delivery activities.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, guidelines, and presentations on rights delivery progress, highlighting key achievements, risks, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the preparation of tournament debrief documentation.
  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree, ideally in Sports Management, Sports Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, with exposure to commercial/marketing operations or sponsorship activations.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced, and project-driven environment, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial operations and/or sponsorship activations in major event settings and/or the sports industry.
  • Experience working in international sports events or large-scale event environments is considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of fan experience areas and activations is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Very strong administrative skills, with proven ability to produce high-quality documentation, guidelines, reports, and structured tracking tools.
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and a structured working approach.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and deliver projects within an event environment, manage priorities effectively, and work independently within defined responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Service-oriented mindset with a proactive and solution-driven approach to commercial rights delivery.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and perform effectively under tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistence, and resilience in dynamic environments.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time).

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Technology Focus

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:

  • RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.
  • Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
  • LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI.
  • Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling.
  • OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments.

These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management.

Location

We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What You Will Focus On

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach.
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise.
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth.
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product.
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team.
  • Write high‑quality code to create new features.
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them.
  • Review code produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.

What We Are Looking For in You

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.
  • Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.
  • Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Performance engineering and security experience.

What We Offer You

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Junior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments.

You will support the creative development of Brand assets, ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives.

This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports creative process from concept to execution across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs & produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.
  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines, with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS‑ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports-related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Analista de Comunicação Pl
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir o suporte operacional da área de comunicação, zelando pelo fluxo de informações internas e externas, pela reputação e unidade visual da marca. Atuar no suporte direto à liderança da área na implementação das estratégias e iniciativas de comunicação, engajamento de colaboradores, relacionamento com comunidades e stakeholders estratégicos.
  • Comunicação interna: Redigir e diagramar comunicados, newsletters e conteúdos para canais internos (e-mail, whatsapp, quadros de avisos).
  • Gestão da marca: Zelar pela aplicação correta da marca em apresentações, sinalizações de unidades operacionais, uniformes, frota.
  • Apoio a eventos: Auxiliar na organização de visitas técnicas, eventos de cultura, ações de endomarketing e reuniões estratégicas da liderança.
  • Suporte administrativo: Gestão de rotinas administrativas (notas fiscais, interface com fornecedores (gráficas, agências) e controle de estoque de materiais de comunicação).
  • Criação básica: Desenvolver peças simples de design (cards, banners e apresentações) seguindo o guia de marca da companhia.
  • Redes sociais: Organizar o cronograma de postagens, garantindo que as lideranças validem os conteúdos antes da veiculação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Superior completo em Comunicação Social, Jornalismo, RP ou Publicidade.
  • Pacote Office: Nível intermediário (foco em PowerPoint para apresentações executivas e Excel para planejamento de ações).
  • Redação: Domínio da língua portuguesa e capacidade de síntese.
  • Senso Estético: Conhecimento em ferramentas de edição (Canva, Photoshop ou Illustrator) para pequenos ajustes e diagramações.
  • Senso de urgência: Capacidade de priorizar demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Visão sistêmica: Entender como a comunicação impacta a operação na ponta e a percepção da marca pelos stakeholders.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Postura de dono para resolver desafios do dia a dia com protagonismo e proatividade.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Habilidade para transitar entre áreas, pares e colegas para executar os entregáveis com excelência.
  • Foco em solução: Ser proativo na identificação de gargalos de comunicação e sugerir melhorias no processo.
  • Requisitos obrigatórios: Possuir CNH categoria B válida e ativa.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale transporte
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

Para sua saúde e bem-estar:

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Programas e Campanhas desenvolvidos para promover o autocuidado da saúde e bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores e seus familiares.

Para sua flexibilidade e rotina:

Conheça nossa SER (Associação dos Colaboradores Renner S.A.) que dá acesso à mais benefícios:

  • Univers - desconto nas farmácias Raia e Drogasil;

  • Ingressos de cinemas, parques e muito mais.

Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas em todas as nossas oportunidades.

Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos.

Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

A fim de construir um time dedicado a revolucionar o padrão de relacionamento com o cliente, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e empreendedores, prontos para desafiar o status quo e oferecer uma experiência com um diferencial competitivo no mercado.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor(a) Comercial Interno:

Você será responsável por atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira através de um dos nossos 4 canais de comunicação (e-mail, chat, whatsapp ou telefone) e por CRM.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Garantir o cumprimento dos acordos comerciais firmados com os clientes.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência de, no mínimo, 1 ano na área Comercial;
  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo;
  • Experiência no contato com o cliente de forma ativa e B2B;
  • Comunicação clara e eficiente;
  • Proficiência em gestão de múltiplos canais;
  • Competência em criar e fortalecer relacionamento com os clientes e time;
  • Habilidade de identificar, analisar e resolver problemas de maneira assertiva;
  • Resiliência e flexibilidade para se adaptar a mudanças com espírito empreendedor.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência com gestão de carteira;
  • Ter experiência com CRM;
  • Compreensão sólida do negócio e do setor;
  • Autogestão diária na definição dos objetivos, organização das tarefas e avaliação do próprio desempenho;
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar métricas de sucesso para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h, dependendo do polo em que será alocada.

Modelo/Local de trabalho:

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Análise de perfil: Nesta etapa você realizará uma conversa inicial com nossa Inteligência Artificial - Stoninha, em parceria com a DigAí.

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

description:
Rio de Janeiro, BRA

A CloudKitchens apoia donos de restaurantes em todo o mundo a terem sucesso no delivery online. Nosso objetivo é tornar a alimentação mais acessível, conveniente e de alta qualidade para todos.

Transformamos propriedades subutilizadas em cozinhas inteligentes (smart kitchens), permitindo que restaurantes atendam melhor seus clientes e contribuam positivamente para as comunidades onde estão inseridos. Sempre que inauguramos uma nova unidade, geramos empregos locais e temos orgulho de oferecer uma ampla variedade de culinárias e opções de alimentação saudável a preços acessíveis.

Estamos revolucionando o setor gastronômico, atendendo desde empreendedores que estão iniciando seu primeiro negócio até grandes redes globais de fast food.

O que você irá fazer

  • Atuar como consultor de confiança: Construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes em potencial e apoiá-los na expansão de seus negócios por meio das soluções de delivery otimizadas da CloudKitchens.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas: Desde o primeiro contato (inbound) até o fechamento do contrato, sendo responsável por todas as etapas do processo comercial.
  • Nutrir leads: Acompanhar os prospects ao longo de todo o funil de vendas, garantindo que suas necessidades sejam atendidas e esclarecendo eventuais dúvidas.
  • Superar expectativas de desempenho: Cumprir e exceder metas e indicadores-chave de performance (KPIs).
  • Desenvolver sua carreira: Tornar-se especialista em princípios, processos e melhores práticas de vendas, investindo em uma carreira sólida e de longo prazo na CloudKitchens.
  • Experiência em vendas: Entre 2 e 3 anos de atuação em vendas de ciclo completo (full-cycle), em funções com metas claras e histórico comprovado de alcance e superação de objetivos.
  • Habilidades de venda consultiva: Perfil analítico, curiosidade intelectual e forte capacidade de negociação e fechamento.
  • Comunicação eficaz: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, tanto presencialmente quanto por telefone.
  • Orientação para resultados: Foco consistente em metas e convicção de que a disciplina nas atividades diárias, semanais e mensais conduz ao sucesso.
  • Ética de trabalho: Forte senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento e motivação para alcançar alta performance. Perfil dinâmico, competitivo e orientado à excelência.
  • Observação: Esta posição exige atuação integral em português. No entanto, a proficiência em inglês será considerada um diferencial.
  • Crescimento exponencial do mercado: A demanda por delivery online cresce aceleradamente. Nos últimos cinco anos, somente nos Estados Unidos, o mercado expandiu dez vezes (de US$ 10 bilhões para US$ 100 bilhões) e pode atingir entre US$ 500 bilhões e US$ 1 trilhão até 2030.
  • Transformação do setor: Você fará parte de uma equipe que impulsiona o sucesso de restaurantes na era digital.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Contará com o apoio de colegas e líderes experientes, trabalhando de forma integrada com diferentes áreas para garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

Informações adicionais

Esta posição é baseada em nosso escritório no Riode Janeiro. Como uma empresa orientada pela inovação e pela evolução contínua, valorizamos a colaboração presencial. Estamos constantemente reinventando nossa indústria, desenvolvendo novos produtos e aprimorando processos — e acreditamos que nossos melhores resultados acontecem quando trabalhamos juntos. Por isso, nossas equipes atuam presencialmente cinco dias por semana.

VTEX é a plataforma de comércio completa que proporciona mais eficiência e menos manutenção para organizações que buscam fazer investimentos mais inteligentes em TI e modernizar sua estrutura de tecnologia. Através da nossa abordagem pragmática, capacitamos marcas, distribuidores e varejistas com uma flexibilidade incomparável e soluções abrangentes, permitindo que invistam apenas no que oferece uma vantagem clara para o negócio e aumenta a lucratividade.

A VTEX é confiada por 2.400 clientes globais B2C e B2B, incluindo Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker e Whirlpool, operando 3.400 lojas online ativas em 43 países (dados do ano fiscal encerrado em 31 de dezembro de 2024).

Fundada no ano 2000, a VTEX tem uma trajetória de crescimento imbatível. Desafiando todas as probabilidades, estamos liderando a indústria de alta tecnologia e nos posicionando acima de gigantes do mercado. Na VTEX, você trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, colaborando com colegas incríveis. Se você tem força individual, junte-se a nós e, juntos, seremos imparáveis.

INCLUSÃO E ACESSIBILIDADE

Na VTEX, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que a inclusão é essencial para o nosso sucesso. Esta vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) como parte do nosso compromisso em promover um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. Acreditamos na geração de oportunidades como ferramenta de mudança e estamos focados em encontrar talentos diversos para nossos times! Estamos comprometidos em adaptar nossas instalações e ferramentas para garantir a acessibilidade de todos os nossos colaboradores, bem como dos candidatos do processo seletivo. Se você precisar de alguma adequação especial para participar do nosso processo seletivo, por favor, nos informe.

Principais áreas que recrutamos:

Essa é nosso banco de talentos de Diversidade, focado em Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência. Nosso time de Recrutamento está constantemente revisando os currículos que chegarem por aqui, e quando identificamos uma ótima oportunidade, entramos em contato com as pessoas para que elas participem do nosso processo de recrutamento.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Todas as pessoas com deficiência podem se inscrever nessa página e em qualquer outra vaga na nossa página de carreiras. Aqui, seu perfil será revisado e, se houver compatibilidade, encaminhado para áreas nas quais estamos contratando. Caso você não se identifique como uma pessoa com deficiência, confira nossas outras oportunidades na página de carreiras da VTEX.
