O CEL tem como missão proporcionar uma educação global de excelência, norteada por valores humanos, contribuindo para formar cidadãos íntegros e capazes de realizar as suas potencialidades.

Estamos buscando um Orientador Educacional protagonista para ajudar os alunos a se prepararem para o aproveitamento acadêmico, desenvolver o projeto de vida e competências pessoais ou sociais.

É importante que tenha o compromisso de assegurar os nossos três pilares (alta qualidade de ensino; educação do caráter e formação global) para todos os estudantes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Cabe à Orientação Educacional a implementação de projetos específicos junto aos alunos, de acordo com a demanda do cotidiano escolar. Tais projetos visam, primordialmente, ao sucesso acadêmico através de estímulo ao potencial de cada aluno, ao seu bem-estar social, à valorização de suas habilidades e aptidões e ao desenvolvimento de valores essenciais à realização de uma vida plena.

  • Observar e zelar pelo cumprimento das leis em vigor e, em especial, pelos dados pessoais de todos os tomadores dos serviços educacionais, como descrito neste regimento;

Somos uma galera que ama burger e acredita que comida boa deixa a vida mais feliz! ??? Tudo começou em 2016, quando um grupo de amigos apaixonados por hambúrguer decidiu criar algo diferente. Quem somos?

Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público‑privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

  • Um supervisor que será responsável por gerenciar e coordenar todas as operações relacionadas ao Serviço de Rouparia dentro do Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Seu principal objetivo é aplicar métodos de Engenharia de Produção, otimização de processos e logística (ex.: Lean) para garantir o fluxo eficiente, o controle estatístico da qualidade, o abastecimento adequado e a máxima produtividade do enxoval hospitalar (limpo e sujo), contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade da assistência e a prevenção de infecções hospitalares.

Dia a dia

  • Supervisionar a equipe do Serviço de Rouparia no desempenho de suas atividades, orientando e treinando‑a no que se fizer necessário.
  • Otimizar e controlar o abastecimento de roupas, dimensionando o enxoval ideal por setor (inventário cíclico e de segurança), utilizando métodos de previsão e planejamento logístico (Forecasting).
  • Interagir com os coordenadores e supervisores das diversas áreas, com a finalidade de acompanhar e avaliar as atividades da equipe de segregação e distribuição do enxoval nos setores.
  • Gerenciar para que as atividades sejam realizadas de acordo com as indicações e orientações do Setor de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar (SCIH), especialmente no manejo do enxoval.
  • Gerenciar os custos operacionais (OPEX), aplicando a análise da causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis) para reduzir perdas (extravios/danos) e otimizar o ciclo de vida do enxoval.
  • Elaborar a escala de trabalho e o cronograma de férias dos colaboradores.
  • Elaborar e gerenciar o cumprimento do Plano de Ação Setorial, desenvolvendo e monitorando indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) como Taxa de Perda, Custo por Peça Processada e Nível de Serviço.
  • Aplicar os Manuais de Boas Práticas estabelecidos, o Manual de Acreditação ONA 2014 e o RAG - Requisitos de Apoio à Gestão.
  • Prover a gerência de informações por meio de relatórios analíticos e dashboards que subsidiem tomadas de decisões estratégicas e baseadas em dados (data‑driven).
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento do contrato de Interação de Processos.
  • Avaliar a equipe quanto ao desempenho, assiduidade, pontualidade e disciplina.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas à área.

8h às 18h de segunda a quinta‑feira | 8h às 17h na sexta‑feira

  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes, liderança e comunicação.

Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and proposes corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measure for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floorplans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager works alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reports to the Head of Sustainability. The role is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services. As the Tournament draws closer, the role will evolve from planning into operations, resulting in an assignment to a competition or non‑competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to:
  • Ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including auditing official sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements and ensuring improvements are implemented.
  • Work with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Develop and deliver accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.

Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:

  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:

  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti‑Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • Deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • 5+ years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment and complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritisation and independent work.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.

description:
Ticketing Electronic Access Control Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager , the Ticketing Electronic Access Control Manager oversees the Ticketing Electronic Access Control project for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Ticketing Operations team in Zurich as well as other key individuals responsible for the delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the Ticketing Electronic Access Control (TEAC) project for ticket holders in close collaboration with all relevant stakeholders;
  • Coordinate the definition of access control specification and the implementation of interfaces between the central ticketing system(s) and the access control solutions used at the competition venues;
  • Manage the TEAC technical requirements, configuration and ticketing system related configurations required for EAC system integration;
  • Development of integration plan and system requirements;
  • Issue access control documentations and organize workshops, tests and inspections with all relevant parties;
  • Support the definition of flow data for ticket holders and define access rules based on available variables and according to operational concept and established flow data;
  • Monitor the access control interfaces and facilitate issue resolution with all relevant parties;
  • Setup the ticketing system to support access control testing (integration, stadium and match day);
  • Support the mobile ticketing project and provide required support for configuration, deployment, testing and maintenance;
  • Prepare training materials and deliver trainings in preparation of match day operations;
  • Oversee and coordinate the operations of several access control venue staff during the tournament;
  • Monitor the access control interfaces and data exchange, as well as facilitate issue resolution with relevant parties;
  • Reporting on data exchange and Match Day operation;
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones
  • Experience in Electronic Access Control, Facial Recognition, IT system, Integrations or Data Exchange projects
  • 3-5 year in ticketing project for international sporting events with experience in managing Electronic Access Control systems
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Strong IT proficiency, especially with ticketing systems including understanding of networks and databases
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across internal functional areas as well as external stakeholders
  • Strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos em busca de uma liderança que entenda que a Ciência de Dados e a Inteligência Artificial são meios, não fins.   • Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, garantindo um ambiente de alta performance e colaboração.

  • Curadoria de IA: Atuar como um guia técnico para decidir quando usar modelos tradicionais de Machine Learning ou quando apostar em novas frentes, como LLMs e IA Generativa.

  • Experiência com Liderança: Vivência comprovada na coordenação de equipes técnicas (Cientistas, Engenheiros ou Analistas de Dados).
  • Visão de Projeto: Domínio de metodologias ágeis aplicadas à ciência de dados (como CRISP-DM, Kanban ou Scrum adaptado).
  • Bagagem Técnica: Conhecimento sólido sobre o ciclo de vida de modelos (do EDA ao Deploy/MLOps) para apoiar o time em tomadas de decisão.
  • Familiaridade com o Ecossistema de IA: Entendimento sobre as diversas aplicações de IA (não apenas modelos preditivos, mas também o potencial da IA Generativa e automação).
  • Comunicação Executiva: Capacidade de reportar resultados técnicos de forma clara para diretorias e clientes internos.

title: Human Rights Manager
description:
Human Rights Manager

Department: Social Responsibility & Education

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the development and delivery of key Sustainability Strategy initiatives to:

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023™ Sustainability Team:

  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

YOUR PROFILE

Minimum requirements:

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights;
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes;
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage:

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations;
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events;
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition;
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards;
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders;
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications;
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique knowledge and skills:

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe;
  • Self-motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate;
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written);
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills;
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds; and
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio-political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products).

2026's vision and (how this role contributes)

In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance .

Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that:

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU),
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue,
  • Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one‑click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.

Challenges and opportunities (what you’ll own)

  • World‑class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first‑layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real‑time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low‑latency ads decisioning and NuPay real‑time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One‑click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one‑click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One‑Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost‑effective infra.

What you’ll find in the team

  • High‑calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high‑impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real‑time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi‑partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.

What you’ll navigate

  • Heavy cross‑BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re‑architecture or open‑scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third‑party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade‑offs between accelerating one‑stack migration and accepting short‑term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?:

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols

  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort-level experiment tracking

  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development.

You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To succeed in this role, you typically have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, you will find:

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

About Canals

Canals is a fully remote, profitable startup transforming the industrial supply chain ($10T industry) with AI. Our platform seamlessly integrates with the systems distributors already use, automating tedious tasks and reducing failure points in moving physical goods across the globe.

We’re an 80‑person team (~50 in engineering), located across North and South America.

The Role

We’re hiring a Technical Support Agent to help distributors get fast, effective support as they scale on Canals. Our customers rely on our platform for mission‑critical workflows — and maintaining a 1‑minute average response time is part of what sets our team apart.

You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, guide users through our tools, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer experience. You’ll also gain exposure to the systems that power our platform — working with tools like Zendesk, Postman, FullStory, and SQL to diagnose and resolve issues.

If you’re a sharp communicator with strong technical instincts and love solving problems quickly and clearly, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat and email, maintaining our 1‑minute average first response time.
  • Troubleshoot product and integration issues, escalating when needed to Support Engineers or Product.
  • Use Postman to test API endpoints and SQL to run basic queries for debugging or validation.
  • Investigate customer behavior and issues using FullStory session data.
  • Collaborate closely with CSMs and the Solutions team to ensure smooth onboarding and post‑launch support.
  • Document resolutions and update internal Zendesk macros and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify recurring issues and propose process or product improvements.

What You'll Bring

  • Typically, 1–3 years of experience in technical support for a SaaS product.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you explain technical issues clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to translate complex topics for non‑technical users.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving startup environment.
  • A genuine sense of urgency — you take pride in speed and quality.

description:
Department

Social Responsibility & Education

Location

Brazil

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone.
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms.
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities.
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.
  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes.
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidate Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations.
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events.
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition.
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards.
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

description:
Job type: Full-time employee

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem, no setor de Nefrologia/Hemodiálise, e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Realizar orientações aos pacientes;
  • Manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis;
  • Orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e equipe multiprofissional;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;
  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Qualificações e Condições

  • Nível superior completo em enfermagem.
  • Registro ativo e regular com anuidade paga no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN-RJ).
  • Comprovação, por meio de certificado, de especialização na área de atuação.
  • Comprovação de, no mínimo, 6 meses de experiência atuando como enfermeiro na área de atuação (Hemodiálise).
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x60 ainda a serem definidas.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

title: PRODUCT OWNER
description:
Sobre a Vaga


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner com perfil estratégico e relacional para liderar a evolução de produtos e soluções voltadas para o segmento de órgãos institucionais, com foco especial em demandas técnicas do DETRAN. O PO será responsável por traduzir necessidades complexas do cliente em requisitos claros, gerenciar o backlog de produto e garantir a entrega de valor contínuo.


A posição combina análise técnica profunda, relacionamento estratégico com stakeholders (DETRAN, despachantes, entidades e parceiros público-privado) e gestão ágil de produto, com atuação tanto remota quanto em campo para melhor compreensão das demandas.


Principais responsabilidades



  • Elicitar, analisar e documentar requisitos técnicos e funcionais, especialmente de demandas complexas do DETRAN e órgãos institucionais.

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de produto, alinhando com objetivos estratégicos e necessidades do cliente.

  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas (desenvolvimento, arquitetura) e stakeholders (DETRAN, clientes, parceiros), garantindo alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Conduzir reuniões de refinamento, validação e aceite de requisitos com foco em clareza e viabilidade técnica.

  • Acompanhar e validar entregas, garantindo conformidade com requisitos e padrões de qualidade.

  • Participar ativamente em campo, com visitas a clientes e órgãos para melhor compreensão do contexto operacional e demandas técnicas.

  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com DETRAN e demais stakeholders, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

  • Preparar e acompanhar indicadores de produto (ex.: adoção, satisfação, impacto técnico, ROI).

  • Participar de reuniões internas e alinhar ações com áreas envolvidas (desenvolvimento, operações, comercial, suporte).

  • Documentar decisões, trade-offs e aprendizados para manutenção de histórico e conhecimento institucional.


Requisitos



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em papel similar (mínimo 2-3 anos).

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro ou similar).

  • Forte capacidade de análise técnica e compreensão de arquitetura de software, APIs e integrações.

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes institucionais, órgãos públicos ou ambientes regulados é um diferencial.

  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e capacidade de conduzir conversas complexas com diferentes perfis técnicos e não-técnicos.

  • Organização para documentação, rastreamento de requisitos e gestão de prioridades.

  • Conforto com rotina híbrida: remoto + campo (visitas e agendas presenciais).

  • Conhecimento em domínios como DETRAN, trânsito, licitações ou parcerias público-privada é um diferencial.


Desejável



  • Conhecimento estruturado em governança de TI baseado em COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies), incluindo governança e gestão orientada a valor, gestão de riscos, compliance, controles e alinhamento estratégico entre negócio e tecnologia.

  • Domínio prático de frameworks ágeis, especialmente Scrum, incluindo gestão de backlog, sprint planning, review, retrospectiva, escrita de user stories, critérios de aceite e priorização por valor.

  • Conhecimento ou certificação em PMP (Project Management Professional), com entendimento do ecossistema de gestão de projetos, incluindo PMBOK, gestão de escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, riscos e stakeholders.

  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes híbridos de gestão (ágil + tradicional), conectando produto, projeto e governança.

  • Conhecimento complementar desejável: ITIL, Lean, Lean Inception, Design Thinking, Product Discovery e Delivery, OKRs e métricas de produto.


Perfil



  • Estratégico e orientado a valor/resultado

  • Relacional e comunicativo, com capacidade de influência

  • Ágil e adaptável a mudanças

  • Organizado(a), disciplinado(a) e orientado(a) a indicadores

  • Proativo(a) e altamente comprometido(a)

  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos

Summary

Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only‑at‑Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Job Overview

As a Senior Manager, you’re responsible for creating a positive environment of customer interactions that effectively drive achievement of performance goals and business priorities. You help drive your store’s vision and purpose, develop other managers, and support the Store Leader with business strategies and critical decision making. While a Senior Manager leads specific parts of the experience, you also help identify, analyze, and solve complex problems in partnership with Store Leader.

Responsibilities

Lead a team (including Managers), empowering each team member to learn, grow, and achieve performance and developmental goals.

Assist with recruiting, training, developing, and retaining a diverse, high‑performing team.

Actively participate in Floor Leadership by interacting with team members and customers throughout the store, modeling what good looks like, and making sure that business priorities are met and exceptional customer service is delivered.

Address customer and team member concerns and escalations, and partner with leadership and key business or People partners when appropriate.

Drive business priorities and achieve store performance goals by establishing, planning, and executing the operational strategy of assigned functional areas and the entire store.

Maintain and uphold company policies and procedures, and protect all company assets, including confidential business, customer, team member, and financial information.

Perform other tasks as needed.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Be a role model for inclusive leadership behaviors and build, develop, and retain diverse teams.

Take action to create a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all team members.

Minimum Qualifications

  • You should: Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
  • You should: Have 3 years of leadership experience in retail, sales, or a related field.
  • You should: Be proficient in English and the local language, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You can: Exceed goals successfully, and persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks.
  • You can: Follow through on commitments and establish mechanisms to encourage others to do the same.
  • You can: Instill trust within the team and operate with a high level of integrity.

  • You can: Communicate with excellence, and tailor your communication style to different audiences.
  • You can: Develop others through mentorship, coaching, and effective feedback.
  • You can: Provide support and guide others through challenges, and step in to handle difficult conversations, while remaining calm in a fast‑paced and constantly changing retail environment.
  • You can: Manage work through effective organization, planning, and prioritization.

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Apple provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities and in accordance with local requirements. Apple is a drug‑free workplace.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à area de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Realizar a contra referência do paciente à Unidade Básica de Saúde de sua referência após a alta ambulatorial ou durante o acompanhamento dos casos crônicos que permanecerem por mais tempo em acompanhamento no serviço conforme Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria em pneumologista

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that, for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Department

Communications

Location

Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)

The Junior Graphic Designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil, will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America, with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world‑class graphic design excellence, strong project‑management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in sports and entertainment. It reports to the Global Head of Brand, Marketing & Promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports the creative process from concept to execution across channels, ensuring high‑quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs and produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develops key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital‑first creative assets.
  • Ensures strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic design experience in brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High‑level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

Your Profile

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven hands‑on expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large‑scale brand projects and live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word, PowerPoint, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports‑related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Acompanhar as punch lists dos projetos concluídos, bem como seus respectivos orçamentos.

  • Principal interface com equipes HSE/ENV quanto à evolução de GHG/CFR.
  • Responsável pelo cálculo e reporte das emissões dos Ativos Operados para todos os exercícios orçamentários e Long Term Plan.
  • Melhorar o reporte atual e visibilidade dos projetos relacionados a GHG/consumo de energia via Power BI.

Parceiros / Stakeholders / Autoridades

  • Organizar/participar de workshops e reuniões relacionadas a CFR com stakeholders-chave, incluindo autoridades.
  • Atuar como agente influenciador junto aos parceiros da TotalEnergies EP Brasil no que diz respeito à redução de emissões.
  • Preparar e apresentar os KPIs das emissões dos Ativos Operados durante todas as reuniões com parceiros.

Responsabilitás

  • Acompanhar a estratégia de desenvolvimento dos ativos com rigoroso respeito aos padrões de segurança.
  • Gerar informações técnicas disponíveis, completas, coerentes e validadas para os Ativos Operados (planejamento, custos, valor) para uso interno (budget, LTP, decisões gerenciais) e externo (parceiros, governo).
  • Garantir a adequada preparação, execução e entrega de temas CFR/GHG nos exercícios de planejamento (LTP, Budget).
  • QA/QC de todos os dados consolidados e transmitidos.

Profil du candidat

  • Graduação em Engenharia.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em Upstream Oil & Gas, com experiência em atividades operacionais.
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI
  • Conhecimento e cultura de HSE.
  • Background técnico sólido e amplo para garantir coordenação transversal entre entidades (Geociências, Poços, Planejamento, Economia, Execução de Projetos, Operações de Campo, Finanças e Controle de Custos).
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação; capacidade de adaptação e gestão de tarefas diversas em contextos variados; reconhecida habilidade de síntese e escuta.
  • Autonomia na organização do trabalho, rigor para produzir resultados/informações validados e sensibilidade à inovação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.

Informations supplémentaires

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.
